fields.statement: When does the daemon start a queued milestone request's plan run? Today every request waits for a free run slot (max runs), oldest first, so a milestone interview can sit behind build runs. / How is the owner told a milestone interview waits on them? Today a notification goes out only when the agent's first AskUserQuestion blocks, which can be minutes after the tab opens, and the inbox lists nothing before that. / Does a usage-reserve hold (the governor holding new launches) also hold a milestone interview's start?
